GROUP BY DATE(payments.confirmed_at) ORDER BY DATE(payments.confirmed_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

ORDER BY orders.created_at DESC, orders.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
